title: Push Sports Event Manager — Frontend implementation plan

requirements.summary: Create mobile-first dark sports themed UI system with persistent bottom navigation (Home, Calendar, Add Event, Payments).
acceptanceCriteria: App is optimized for small screens first (comfortable touch targets, vertical layouts).
Consistent dark sports theme applied across screens (backgrounds, typography, cards, buttons).
Bottom navigation is always accessible and highlights the active tab.
All user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create global Tailwind base + app theme tokens for a consistent dark sports theme (background, surface/cards, primary/accents, typography, focus states) and mobile-first defaults.
Create the root app shell with persistent bottom navigation tabs (Home, Calendar, Add Event, Payments), active-tab highlighting, and a mobile-first layout wrapper.

Implement a persistent bottom navigation component used by App shell for the required tabs and active state styling; compose shadcn-ui primitives where helpful. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a shared layout component providing consistent page padding, top area for status badges, and space for BottomNav; compose shadcn-ui primitives where helpful. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Build the Dashboard (Home) with metrics, upcoming events list, and quick actions navigating to Add Event and Calendar.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows four summary metrics computed from stored events.
Upcoming events list shows events occurring within the next 7 days ordered by date/time.
Quick buttons navigate to Add Event and Calendar screens.
Metrics update after creating/editing/deleting events without requiring a full page reload.

file_operations.description: Create the Home dashboard UI showing four computed metrics and an Upcoming Events (next 7 days) list; include quick actions for Add Event and Calendar; compose shadcn-ui components for cards/buttons/list. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire HomeDashboard into the Home tab and ensure navigation from quick actions to Add Event and Calendar views.
Add React Query hooks to fetch/cached events and expose derived selectors for dashboard metrics and upcoming events; integrate with offline cache layer.

Implement pure utilities to compute: total events this month, upcoming events next 7 days, total revenue this month, and total pending payments from the event list (shared across Home/Calendar/Payments).

requirements.summary: Implement Add New Event form with all fields, validation, pending amount auto-calc, and autosave draft restore/discard.
acceptanceCriteria: All listed fields are present with appropriate input types (date picker, time picker, numeric inputs, long text, dropdown, checkboxes).
Pending Amount is read-only and updates instantly when Total or Advance changes.
Form prevents saving when required fields are missing (show inline errors).
Autosave stores an in-progress draft locally and restores it when returning to the Add Event screen (with a clear way to discard draft).
On successful save, the new event appears in Calendar/Home/Payments as applicable.

file_operations.description: Create the Add Event screen with required fields, inline validation, read-only pending amount auto-calculation, and Save action; include a clear Draft restored banner and Discard draft control; compose shadcn-ui form components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable EventForm component (used for Add and Edit) that owns inputs, validation display, pending amount calculation, and exposes submit/cancel handlers; compose shadcn-ui inputs/select/checkbox/textarea. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement local draft persistence (localStorage) with debounce autosave, restore-on-mount, and explicit discard; scoped to the Add Event screen.
Add validation helpers for required fields and numeric constraints (e.g., advance <= total; pending never negative) used by EventForm.
Wire AddEventPage into the Add Event tab and ensure successful save triggers refresh of event lists/metrics (React Query invalidation) without full reload.

requirements.summary: Implement Event Details screen showing all fields + payment summary + requirements checklist with actions Edit, Delete, Mark as Completed.
acceptanceCriteria: Details page shows all stored fields in a readable mobile layout.
Payment summary includes totalAmount, advancePaid, pendingAmount and a clear paid/unpaid indicator.
Edit navigates to an edit form populated with the existing event data.
Delete requires confirmation and removes the event from all lists and calendar indicators.
Mark as Completed updates status and is reflected everywhere (dashboard metrics, calendar highlighting, payments list).

file_operations.description: Create the Event Details view showing all event fields, payment summary, and requirements checklist; provide Edit/Delete/Mark Completed actions; compose shadcn-ui components (cards, badges, dialogs). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an Edit Event view that reuses EventForm with existing event data prefilled and saves updates through the events hooks; compose shadcn-ui components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a confirmation dialog component for deleting an event and triggering mutation + cache updates; compose shadcn-ui dialog components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add mutations for update/delete/mark-completed and ensure React Query cache invalidation/reconciliation updates all dependent screens.
Wire navigation to EventDetailsPage from lists (Home upcoming, Calendar day list, Payments list) and wire EditEventPage from Details; ensure views are reachable and not orphaned.

requirements.summary: Create monthly calendar view with date selection, daily events list, event detail navigation, and status-based highlights (green upcoming, blue today, red overdue payments).
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar shows a month grid with the ability to move between months.
Selecting a date shows a list of events for that date.
Selecting an event navigates to the Event Details page.
Today’s date and today’s events are visually distinguished in blue.
Upcoming events (future-dated) are visually distinguished in green.
Events with pendingAmount > 0 and event date in the past show a red overdue-payment indicator in the calendar and in the date event list.

file_operations.description: Create the Monthly Calendar view with month navigation, selectable dates, and a selected-day event list; implement highlight rules (today=blue, future=green, overdue payment indicator=red) and navigation to Event Details; compose shadcn-ui components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a reusable month grid component that renders day cells with compact event indicators and selection state; compose shadcn-ui primitives as needed. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add date utilities for month boundaries, day comparisons, and formatting suitable for calendar calculations and consistent display.
Wire CalendarPage into the Calendar tab and ensure event selection routes to EventDetailsPage.

requirements.summary: Implement Payments screen listing events with pendingAmount > 0, total pending, and month filtering with navigation to details.
acceptanceCriteria: Payments screen only shows events where pendingAmount > 0.
Total pending amount is displayed and matches the sum of listed items under the active filter.
User can filter by month and the list + total update accordingly.
Tapping an event navigates to the Event Details page.

file_operations.description: Create the Payments screen with month filter UI, list of pending events only, and total pending amount; tapping an item navigates to Event Details; compose shadcn-ui components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Expose derived selectors/helpers to filter events by month and pendingAmount > 0, and compute total pending under active filter.
Wire PaymentsPage into the Payments tab and ensure list items navigate to EventDetailsPage.

requirements.summary: Add offline-capable local caching + queued change sync with clear offline/pending-sync indicators (single-user).
acceptanceCriteria: App loads previously fetched events from local storage when offline.
User can create/edit/delete events while offline; changes are queued locally.
When connectivity is restored, queued changes sync to the backend and UI reconciles without data loss.
User has a clear indication when the app is offline and/or when changes are pending sync.

file_operations.description: Implement local persistence for events cache and an operation queue (create/update/delete) using localStorage (or IndexedDB if already available in template) with versioned keys and safe serialization.
Add a hook that tracks online/offline state (navigator.onLine + events) and exposes connectivity status for UI badges and sync triggering.
Implement a sync orchestrator that flushes queued operations when online, reconciles results into the local cache, and prevents duplicate replays (idempotency tokens on the client side).
Integrate offlineStore + syncEngine: serve cached events immediately, enqueue mutations when offline, and auto-sync/refresh when connectivity returns; ensure React Query cache stays consistent.

Add a small status component (offline badge / pending changes count / syncing state) to be shown in AppShell; compose shadcn-ui badges/alerts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Render SyncStatusBar prominently (but compact) so users can always see offline/pending-sync state.

requirements.summary: Implement in-browser reminder system using Notification API with permissions flow and in-app fallback reminders panel/badge.
acceptanceCriteria: App requests notification permission with a clear explanation and allows continuing without enabling notifications.

When notifications are permitted, the app schedules/checks reminders locally and triggers notifications at the correct times while the app is active (and where the browser permits background notifications).
If pendingAmount > 0, the app shows a payment reminder notification according to a defined rule (e.g., on event morning and/or after event date passes) and does not spam duplicates.
If notifications are not permitted/available, the app shows an in-app reminders panel/badge as a fallback.

file_operations.description: Implement a local reminder checker that, while the app is running, evaluates upcoming events and payment reminder rules (1 day before, event morning, overdue/pending payments) and triggers Notification API when permitted; store last-fired keys in localStorage to avoid duplicates.
Add a hook to manage permission state, start/stop the reminder engine, and provide fallback reminder items for in-app display when notifications are unavailable/denied.

Create an in-app reminders panel (fallback) that lists due reminders and can be opened from a small badge/icon; compose shadcn-ui dialog/sheet components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire reminders UI entrypoint (badge/button) into the global shell and ensure the reminder engine starts after authentication and events are available.

requirements.summary: Add voice input on Add Event screen using browser speech-to-text to parse a booking sentence and autofill form fields, with graceful degradation.
acceptanceCriteria: Microphone button starts/stops speech recognition and shows listening state.
Recognized text is displayed for review.

App parses common phrases to populate fields (at minimum: eventType from sport words, date, start/end time, organizer name when stated, advance paid, and requirements checkboxes like cafeteria/camera).
User can edit any auto-filled fields before saving.
If speech recognition is not supported, feature degrades gracefully with a helpful message.

file_operations.description: Implement a small wrapper around the Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition) to start/stop listening, stream/finalize transcripts, and expose supported/unsupported state.

Implement lightweight NLP parsing (rules/regex) for common booking phrases to extract sport/eventType keywords, date, start/end time, organizer name, advance amount, and requirements flags (e.g., cafeteria/camera).

Create a microphone control component showing listening state, displaying recognized text for review, and applying parsed values into the EventForm; compose shadcn-ui button/badge components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Integrate VoiceInputButton into the Add Event experience (and optionally Edit) so recognized text can propose field updates without blocking manual editing.
Wire voice input UI into the Add Event page and ensure unsupported browsers show an English helpful message.

requirements.summary: Enforce simple single-user access via Internet Identity and access-denied UI; clear cached data on logout.
acceptanceCriteria: App prevents accidental multi-user use by scoping all data to a single identity/session model (e.g., a single authenticated principal or a single configured owner).
If authentication is used, it relies only on Internet Identity (no third-party auth).
If the user is not the designated user/owner, the app shows an access denied state and does not expose event data.

file_operations.description: Create a Login/Logout button using the existing useInternetIdentity hook and clear React Query cache on logout per the authorization component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks to fetch caller role/profile and a small helper to determine whether to show app content vs access denied; handle authorization failures gracefully in UI.

Add a first-login profile setup modal that asks for the user's name (English UI) and saves it via backend; avoid modal flash by following the authorization component guidance; compose shadcn-ui dialog + inputs. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create an access denied screen that does not show event data and provides a logout option; compose shadcn-ui components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Gate all event data screens behind authentication and authorization checks (require login before loading any event data); show ProfileSetupModal for first-time users; show AccessDeniedScreen when unauthorized; include LoginButton in the shell.
Ensure events queries are disabled until authenticated/authorized; ensure cached events and offline queues are cleared on logout to prevent data leakage across sessions.

requirements.summary: Include generated static visual assets (app icon, subtle sports background, empty state illustration) and render them from frontend static assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and used in the UI (e.g., app icon/branding and at least one empty state).
Assets do not require backend routing and load correctly in production build.

file_operations.description: Add the generated app icon asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png and ensure it is referenced by the UI where appropriate (e.g., auth screen/header branding).
Add the generated subtle sports background asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/sports-bg.dim_1080x1920.png and use it in the app shell as a subtle background layer.

Add the generated empty state illustration at frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-events.dim_1200x800.png and show it in appropriate empty states (e.g., no upcoming events / no events on selected date / no pending payments).

Create a small branding component that renders the app icon (frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png) and optionally a title; compose shadcn-ui typography as needed. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable empty state component that can render frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-events.dim_1200x800.png with English text and optional action button; compose shadcn-ui components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Apply the subtle background using frontend/public/assets/generated/sports-bg.dim_1080x1920.png in a way that preserves readability and performance on mobile.
Use EmptyState (with frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-events.dim_1200x800.png) when there are no upcoming events.
Use EmptyState (with frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-events.dim_1200x800.png) when the selected date has no events.
Use EmptyState (with frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-events.dim_1200x800.png) when there are no pending payments for the selected month.
